The '''Crystal Fountain of Bela Vistal''' was a site that was created shortly after the founding of [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. At that time, the inhabitants transplanted a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] geyser from the [[Agrilat Region]] to the center of their town,<ref name="SWG:CFoBV" /> which attracted all visitors from its small lake. It rose like a jagged rock where it appeared completely black, with dark rose and green veins, and water falling down its sides in smooth curtains that gave a soft relaxing sound.
